name: Via Brabantica, Antwerpen - Mechelen
description_md:
The Via Brabantica between Antwerpen and Mechelen is a waymarked hiking route in BE. It covers a distance of 43.8 km with 259 m of ascent and 260 m of descent.

The walking time is about 12 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and the difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. This route is part of an international waymarked hiking network. Nearby places include Antwerp Diamond Heist within 300 m, Antwerp within 500 m, and Siege of Antwerp within 700 m.

images.caption: The scientific name seems to be Rhynchocyon petersi. Steppeslurfhondje translates as “Small dog of the steppes with a trunk”, but more properly it’s a springmuis. The two on view were full of energy, moving about at high speed.
